facts.statement: Freerealms.com posted a video guide by Referee Ruby covering the pirate-themed content in Free Realms, including how to collect gold doubloons.
facts.quote: Referee Ruby is here to take you through all the Pirate-themed goodies Free Realms has to offer

article_summaries.title: Ref Ruby's Video Guide to Pirates Plunder
article_summaries.summary: A short freerealms.com news post (captured July 2010) presenting Referee Ruby's video guide to the pirate-themed content in Free Realms, specifically how to collect gold doubloons. The page gives no detailed steps, rewards or amounts. The client has a 'Pirates Plunder' minigame string (id 31028), which the article's pirate theme likely refers to.
